metadata.document: Buffs, movement, protection and weather audit v0.1
metadata.status: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY; LEGACY BEHAVIOR, NOT APPROVED DESIGN
metadata.method: Synthetic fixtures invoking sistemas.gwent.aplicar_jogada, _remover_unidade, _resolve_round and _poder_efetivo; no database, HTTP, Discord, browser or production match used.

cases.expected: reject below minimum of two pre-existing allies
cases.observed_error: O Juramento exige pelo menos duas unidades na fileira.

cases.observed: special moved to discard; no same-row ally was buffed

cases.reason: Rara has budget 1; gwent_egide resolves min(3, 1 + budget) targets
base +2 to each; rarity budget 1 adds +1 to the first changed target in board order
Rara budget 1; movement cap is min(3, 1 + budget)

cases.expected: strongest enemy moved from siege to melee; new melee weather applies immediately

cases.reason: identity gives base +1 to first same-row ally; Rara budget 1 amplifies that changed bonus once

cases.finding: the global rarity-diff scan treats a removal-triggered Vengeance bonus as a Chama Negra bonus target
shield is not a universal prevention layer for bonus/status effects

cases.decision_needed: whether weather resistance is persistent card data or a round-scoped modifier

limits: These assertions cover selected branches and interactions, not all 54 candidate effect families or all card/rarity combinations.
They establish the current engine's behavior, not whether that behavior should be retained in the rebuilt engine.
No full competitive simulation, HTTP dispatch, production database, Discord runtime, or browser interaction was performed.
Target tie-breaking, physical instance identity, and duration of weather_resist remain design questions.
